policy: Corrects only clear errors in source labels, found on widely known works or in the human audit sample, judged against the work's standard bibliographic description. Removing labels is preferred over adding them. Country follows Wikidata's country of origin, which usually records the country of first publication; corrections never switch it to an author-origin rule. Raw Wikidata statements stay in source_selection.jsonl. A work left with no mapped genre leaves the catalog.
review: The human audit reviewed a sample of these corrections (catalog_audit_sample.json).
